text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Assad talks by phone with Lebanese President Hrawi to exchange New Year greetings.
- New funds for Israeli settlements in West Bank and Golan.
- U.S. President Clinton encouraged by Hebron talks between Israel and Palestinians. Palestinian President Arafat says meeting with Israeli pemier Netanyahu put off.
- Israeli warplanes raid south Lebanon villages.
- cabinet briefed on Cairo meetings of foreign ministers of the Damascus Declaration.
- Iranian housing minister to visit Syria tomorrow.
- Syria hosts meetings of the Arab Bar Union.
- Oman closes its trade office in israel.
